# The twinless spice-bench block through ngspice-vacask (`spice_bench_twinless_to_vacask`, the decks of
# spice-bench-twinless.txt): `<deck> <step> <class> <proof>`, compared both ways by (deck, step).
# The 34 OSDI decks name `../osdi_libs/<x>.osdi`, which the store does not ship: they cannot run as
# they stand (source-environment where they reach step 4; 30 stop at step 2 first). Against
# VACASK's own modules: the decks want bsimbulk107, VACASK ships bsimbulk106 (another Verilog-A
# source); psp103v4's version against the decks' psp103 is unchecked; VACASK has no bsimcmg,
# HICUM L0 (HICUML0-2) or Mextram (bjt504t) module; vbic_1p3 may pair with hicuml0/vbic_out.
# Compiling them (OpenVAF) is the user's decision. Recorded on pair-test after b91a06dc.
